userDecisions: 2026-10-20: single Devin Fusion entry in /model; /fusion picks lead group and sidekick model, saved globally; sidekick may run in the background like the CLI (default wait, block:false background, report wakes the lead); per-handoff sidekick budget from PI_DEVIN_MAX_MODEL_CALLS; sidekick tools equal the lead's active tools without Fusion tools.
reference: Design follows UniPi @pi-unipi/fusion 2.20.5 (MIT, Neuron-Mr-White/UniPi 6ac5da3): child Pi RPC sidekick, followUp report delivery, steer while busy. No code was copied.

model.name: Devin Fusion · <lead group> + <sidekick model> · 비용 미상
model.fallback: each saved value outside the current catalog falls back to its default; no default means no Fusion entry

selection.command: /fusion (interactive: lead group → sidekick group → sidekick variant) or /fusion <leadID> <sidekickID>
selection.storage: <agentDir>/pi-devin/fusion.json, schemaVersion 1, atomic rename; unreadable or invalid files are ignored and not overwritten
selection.apply: provider.refreshFusion() then modelRegistry.refresh({ providers: ['devin'], allowNetwork: false }); pi.setModel() when the current model is Fusion

sidekick.process: lead's Node (execArgv without inspect flags) + Pi CLI, --mode rpc, --session <agentDir>/pi-devin/sidekick/<lead session id>.jsonl or --no-session, --model devin/<sidekick uid>, --thinking <its level>, --append-system-prompt <sidekick prompt>, -e <package root>, --tools <lead active tools without sidekick> or --no-tools, plus the lead CLI's -e/--extension/--no-extensions/--no-mcp
sidekick.env: inherits the lead environment and agent dir (same OAuth storage); PI_DEVIN_FUSION_CHILD=1 disables Fusion model/tool/command in the child
sidekick.tool: sidekick({ message, block? }): default waits and returns the report as the tool result; block:false returns immediately; busy → RPC steer; user input while waiting → background; lead abort → RPC abort and no delivery; background report → pi.sendMessage(devin-sidekick-report, { deliverAs: 'followUp', triggerTurn: true }) once
sidekick.lifecycle: lazy spawn per lead session; restart when idle and model/tools/session file change; other sessions' children closed on session_start; all closed on session_shutdown
sidekick.budget: lead execution budget unchanged; each handoff is a child run with its own PI_DEVIN_MAX_MODEL_CALLS budget

findingsFixed: Pi keeps model and availability snapshots; /fusion now refreshes them without network so /model and RPC lists show the new pair even when Fusion is not the current model (found by host-contract).
Extensions loaded only with -e in the lead were missing in the child; the lead CLI's extension-selection arguments are now forwarded.
limitations: The interactive /fusion selector was exercised through the command handler with arguments, not by driving the TUI selector keys.
When a background report arrives while the lead is still running, Pi continues it as a follow-up in the same run; otherwise it starts a new run. Both were accepted by the host check.
Sidekick session files under <agentDir>/pi-devin/sidekick/ are not cleaned up automatically.
The child loads the user's installed packages and MCP servers like a normal Pi start unless the lead CLI disabled them.
No real Devin service was used. 06 must rebuild the archive and 07 must re-run the Fusion case with new approval.
